sources.title: ChindaMT: Thai-English translation that follows your rules, published ...
sources.snippet: iApp Technology releases ChindaMT, a Thai-English translation model family (4B, 2B, 0.8B) that follows rules on tone, terminology, length and format without losing translation quality. Research published at AACL-IJCNLP 2026 (Main Conference). Open weights, data and code under Apache 2.0, and a hosted API at 1 IC per 400 characters.
